chunks: And from among the famous speech of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) when he stood by the grave of Isma'il:

My grief for you [in the afterlife] has overwhelmed my grief on you [in this world]. O Allah, I have gifted Isma'il all that he fell short of regarding my right upon him, so gift me all that he fell short of regarding Your right upon him.

key_terms.حَقُّكَ: Your right (God's right over the creation)
key_terms.حَقِّي: My right (the father's right over the son)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq pray for his son Isma'il at his grave?
ai.summary: This famous supplication, recorded by al-Nu'mani, highlights the theological concept of *tawassul* through the Imam's intercession, where he transfers his personal rights to his son to secure divine mercy. It reflects the Shia belief in the spiritual elevation of the Imams' progeny and the efficacy of the Imam's devotion in atoning for the shortcomings of the faithful.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (7) From among the famous speech of Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) is this saying that he has said when visiting the grave of his son Issma’eel:

“My pity for you is more than my grief on you. O Allah, I have forgiven Issma’eel all that he has failed to achieve due to my right upon him. O Allah, forgive him all that he has failed to achieve due to Your rights upon him!”
